author: RandomGammer
quote:
Just not a fan of some of the optional features; while this game is unique it’s just a pain at some points of gameplay the daily routines and stuff are rather annoying yes they’re optional but if you don’t do them it effects your character 

The NPCs and how they act was a unique idea in concept but in actual gameplay I find them a little annoying at times. The older games where they were just there was nice 

Not a horrid game but with its current price tag and restrictions I don’t see the point of playing the game
